report_notes: Swoole was measured on October 7, 2026; the other ten runtimes retain their October 5 measurements. These were separate sessions on the same host, not a simultaneous full rerun.

Swoole 6.2.3 uses PHP 8.5.11, 20 workers in process mode, asynchronous reloads after 10,000 requests, and disabled coroutine request handling and compression. PostgreSQL max_connections=2000 and opcache.enable_file_override=1.
Swoole uses the same default 13-stage ramp, 30 seconds per stage, 32 load-generator threads, and 256 HTTP connections.
Unrelated development containers were running on the host during the Swoole measurements.

Both Swoole scenarios completed all 13 stages with zero errors. PostgreSQL connections were sampled every 30 seconds and peaked at 21, including the monitoring connection; samples are not a continuous peak measurement.
